celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ﴾ that is, they were unable to rise when the punishment came down; ﴿وَمَا كَانُوا مُنْتَصِرِينَ﴾ against the One who destroyed them.

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿وَقَوْمِ نُوحٍ﴾ in the genitive, conjoined to ثَمُودَ, that is: and in their destruction by what is in the heaven and the earth there is a sign; and in the accusative, that is: and We destroyed the people of Noah; ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ that is, before the destruction of those mentioned; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ﴾ with strength; ﴿وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ﴾ able. One says آدَ الرَّجُلُ يَئِيدُ: he became strong; and أَوْسَعَ الرَّجُلُ: he became a man of capacity and strength.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا﴾ We spread it out level; ﴿فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ﴾ are We.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to His words ﴿خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ two kinds, such as male and female, heaven and earth, sun and moon, plain and mountain, summer and winter, sweet and sour, light and darkness; ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ with one of the two tāʾs of the original form omitted; so that you may know that the Creator of the pairs is One, and so worship Him.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ that is, to His reward, away from His punishment, by obeying Him and not disobeying Him; ﴿إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear in warning.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ Before فَفِرُّوا there is implied (muqaddar): "Say to them".

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ مَا أَتَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا﴾ he is ﴿سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ﴾ that is, like their denial of you by saying "You are a sorcerer or a madman" was the denial of the nations before them of their messengers, by saying that.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿أَتَوَاصَوْا﴾ all of them ﴿بِهِ﴾ — an interrogative in the sense of negation; ﴿بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ﴾ their transgression brought them together upon this saying.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّ﴾ turn away ﴿عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ﴾ because you have conveyed the message to them.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿وَذَكِّرْ﴾ admonish with the Quran; ﴿فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ whoever Allah the Exalted knows will believe.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ﴾ This is not contradicted by the disbelievers' not worshipping, because a purpose need not necessarily come into being, as in your saying "I sharpened this pen in order to write with it", for you may not write with it.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ﴾ for Me or for themselves or for others; ﴿وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ﴾ nor themselves nor others.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ﴾ the Firm (al-shadīd).

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ themselves by disbelief, of the people of Mecca and others, ﴿ذَنُوبًا﴾ a share of the punishment ﴿مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ﴾ the share of ﴿أَصْحَابِهِمْ﴾ who perished before them; ﴿فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ﴾ the punishment, if I defer them until the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾ severity of punishment ﴿لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ﴾ (meaning: in) ﴿يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ﴾ that is, the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿وَالذَّارِيَاتِ﴾ the winds that scatter dust and other things ﴿ذَرْوًا﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun); and one says «تَذْرِيهِ ذَرْيًا»: they blow through it.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿فَالْحَامِلَاتِ﴾ the clouds that carry water ﴿وِقْرًا﴾ a heavy load; the object of «الْحَامِلَات».

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿فَالْجَارِيَاتِ﴾ the ships that run on the surface of the water ﴿يُسْرًا﴾ with ease; a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. made easy.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا﴾ i.e. the angels who apportion provisions, rains and other things among lands and servants.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ﴾ «مَا» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. their being promised the resurrection and other things ﴿لَصَادِقٌ﴾ is surely a true promise.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ﴾ the recompense after the reckoning ﴿لَوَاقِعٌ﴾ inevitably.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ﴾ the plural of «حَبِيكَة», like «طَرِيقَة» and «طُرُق», i.e. possessing paths in its make-up, like the paths [ripples] in sand.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ O people of Mecca, concerning the Prophet ﷺ and the Quran ﴿لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ﴾ it was said: a poet, a sorcerer, a soothsayer; poetry, sorcery, soothsaying.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿يُؤْفَكُ﴾ is turned away ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ from the Prophet ﷺ and the Quran, i.e. from believing in it ﴿مَنْ أُفِكَ﴾ who was turned away from guidance in the knowledge of Allah the Exalted.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ﴾ cursed be the liars, the people of the differing word.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ﴾ an ignorance that overwhelms them ﴿سَاهُونَ﴾ heedless of the matter of the Hereafter.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَ﴾ the Prophet, a question of mockery ﴿أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ﴾ i.e. when will it come? And the answer to them comes [next]:

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ﴾ i.e. they are punished in it, and it is said to them at the time of the punishment:

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ﴾ your punishment ﴿هَذَا﴾ punishment is ﴿الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾ in this world, in mockery.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ orchards ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ flowing in them

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿آخِذِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in the khabar (predicate) of «إِنَّ» ﴿مَا آتَاهُمْ﴾ gave them ﴿رَبُّهُمْ﴾ of reward ﴿إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. their entering the Garden ﴿مُحْسِنِينَ﴾ in this world.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ﴾ they sleep; «مَا» is redundant (zāʾida), «يَهْجَعُونَ» is the khabar (predicate) of «كَانَ», and «قَلِيلًا» is an adverb (ẓarf), i.e. they sleep for a small portion of the night and pray most of it.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ﴾ saying: "O Allah, forgive us."

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ﴾ who does not ask, out of restraint.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَفِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ of mountains, seas, trees, plants and other things ﴿آيَاتٌ﴾ indications of the power of Allah, Glorified and Exalted is He, and His oneness ﴿لِلْمُوقِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ there are signs too, from the beginning of your creation to its end, and the wonders in the composition of your make-up ﴿أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ﴾ that, so that you infer from it its Maker and His power?

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ﴾ i.e. the rain, which causes the plants that are provision ﴿وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ﴾ of the return, reward and punishment; i.e. that is written in the heaven.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. what you are promised ﴿لَحَقٌّ مِثْلُ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُونَ﴾ with «مِثْلُ» in the nominative as an adjective, with «مَا» redundant; and with fatḥa on the lām [مِثْلَ], compounded with «مَا». The meaning is: like your speech in its reality, i.e. its being known to you necessarily, since it issues from you.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿هَلْ أَتَاكَ﴾ addressed to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ﴾ they were angels, twelve, or ten, or three, among them Jibrīl.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for «حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ» ﴿دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا﴾ i.e. this word ﴿قَالَ سَلَامٌ﴾ i.e. this word ﴿قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ﴾ we do not know them; he said that to himself; and it is the khabar (predicate) of an implied (muqaddar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هَؤُلَاءِ» (these are).

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿فَرَاغَ﴾ he turned ﴿إِلَى أَهْلِهِ﴾ secretly ﴿فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ﴾ and in Sūrat Hūd «بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ», i.e. roasted.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ he offered them food, and they did not respond.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿فَأَوْجَسَ﴾ he concealed within himself ﴿مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ﴾ we are messengers of your Lord ﴿وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ﴾ possessed of much knowledge, and he is Isḥāq, as mentioned in Hūd.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ﴾ Sāra ﴿فِي صَرَّةٍ﴾ a cry; a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. she came crying out ﴿فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا﴾ she struck it ﴿وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ﴾ who has never given birth; her age was ninety-nine years and Ibrāhīm's age was a hundred years; or his age was a hundred and twenty years and hers ninety years.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿قَالُوا كَذَلِكِ﴾ i.e. like our word in the good tidings ﴿قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His making ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of His creation.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ disbelievers, i.e. the people of Lūṭ

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ baked by fire

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿مُسَوَّمَةً﴾ marked, bearing the name of the one to be pelted with it ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for it ﴿لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ by their going to males, along with their disbelief.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا﴾ i.e. the towns of the people of Lūṭ ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ in order to destroy the disbelievers.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾ and they were Lūṭ and his two daughters; they are described by both īmān and islām, i.e. they affirm with their hearts and perform acts of obedience with their limbs.

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا﴾ after destroying the disbelievers ﴿آيَةً﴾ a sign of their destruction ﴿لِلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ﴾ so they do not do the like of what they did.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَفِي مُوسَى﴾ conjoined to «فِيهَا»; the meaning is: and We placed in the story of Mūsā a sign ﴿إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ furnished ﴿بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ with a clear proof.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّى﴾ turned away from faith ﴿بِرُكْنِهِ﴾ with his troops, because they were like a pillar (rukn) to him ﴿وَقَالَ﴾ of Mūsā: he is ﴿سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ﴾

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ﴾ We cast them ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾ the sea, and they drowned ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ i.e. Pharaoh ﴿مُلِيمٌ﴾ doing what he is blamed for, of denying the messengers and claiming lordship.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿وَفِي﴾ the destruction of ﴿عَادٍ﴾ is a sign ﴿إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ﴾ it is the one in which there is no good, because it carries no rain and does not pollinate the trees; and it is the west wind (al-dabūr).

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ soul or property ﴿أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ﴾ like what is decayed and crumbled.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَفِي﴾ the destruction of ﴿ثَمُودَ﴾ is a sign ﴿إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾ after the hamstringing of the she-camel ﴿تَمَتَّعُوا حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾ i.e. until the end of your terms, as in the ayah {تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ}

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿فَعَتَوْا﴾ they were arrogant ﴿عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ i.e. toward complying with it ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ﴾ after three days had passed, i.e. the destroying cry ﴿وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ i.e. by day.
